Kementerian Keuangan Dorong Penguatan Pengawasan DPRD terhadap Pengelolaan Keuangan Daerah

Jakarta (Humas UNAS) – Kementerian Keuangan menilai Dewan Perwakilan Rakyat Daerah (DPRD) memiliki peran strategis dalam mengawasi dan mengawal pengelolaan keuangan daerah. Penguatan fungsi tersebut diperlukan untuk memastikan perencanaan, penganggaran, dan pelaksanaan APBD berjalan secara optimal.

Hal tersebut disampaikan Dr. Subandono, S.E., M.Ec., yang mewakili Direktur Jenderal Perimbangan Keuangan Kementerian Keuangan, dalam Focus Group Discussion (FGD) III “Penguatan Kemandirian Kelembagaan DPRD” di Ruang Seminar Lantai 3, Gedung Menara UNAS, Ragunan, Senin (16/11/2026).

Dalam paparannya melalui zoom meeting, Subandono menyampaikan bahwa masih terdapat berbagai persoalan dalam pengelolaan keuangan pemerintah daerah. Ia mengungkapkan bahwa berdasarkan data yang disampaikannya, terdapat sekitar 8.100 temuan terkait pengelolaan keuangan daerah yang tercatat dalam pemeriksaan Badan Pemeriksa Keuangan (BPK).

Kondisi tersebut menunjukkan pentingnya peran DPRD dalam melakukan pengawasan sekaligus membangun kemitraan yang seimbang dengan pemerintah daerah.

“Peran Bapak, Ibu, teman-teman DPRD di dalam mengawasi, di dalam membina pengelolaan keuangan daerah ini menjadi sangat strategis dan penting,” jelasnya.

Subandono juga menekankan bahwa keterlibatan DPRD diperlukan sejak tahap perencanaan dan penyusunan anggaran. Aspirasi masyarakat, usulan pemerintah daerah, serta kebutuhan pembangunan harus terintegrasi dalam penyusunan APBD.

Selain perencanaan, DPRD juga perlu mengawasi pelaksanaan anggaran agar penyerapan belanja tidak hanya terkonsentrasi pada akhir tahun. Menurutnya, pelaksanaan kegiatan sejak awal tahun dapat memberikan dampak yang lebih optimal terhadap pertumbuhan ekonomi daerah.

Ia turut menyoroti pentingnya pengawasan terhadap pemenuhan belanja wajib pemerintah daerah, termasuk belanja pegawai dan berbagai program prioritas pemerintah pusat yang perlu diakomodasi sesuai kebutuhan daerah.

Subandono menyatakan dukungannya terhadap upaya penguatan kelembagaan DPRD agar mampu menjalankan fungsi pengawasan dan menciptakan mekanisme check and balances yang lebih baik.

Ia berharap penguatan DPRD dapat berjalan seiring dengan perbaikan tata kelola keuangan daerah dan peningkatan kualitas penyelenggaraan pemerintahan. (*Dimas Wijaksono)

Dari Panggung Nusantara ke Dunia, Kemenko PMK Dorong Wayang Menjadi Jembatan Emas Inklusivitas Global

KEMENKO PMK – Kementerian Koordinator Bidang Pembangunan Manusia dan Kebudayaan (Kemenko PMK) mendorong optimalisasi peran pewayangan tidak sekadar sebagai warisan masa lalu, melainkan sebagai instrumen diplomasi budaya untuk membangun dialog antarbangsa dan menyebarkan nilai universal kemanusiaan di kancah global.

Pesan pelestarian dan inklusivitas tersebut ditekankan dalam penyelenggaraan The 6th Living Intangible Cultural Heritage (ICH) Forum for Wayang Puppet Theater in Indonesia, yang dirangkaikan dengan Peringatan Hari Wayang Nasional ke-8 di Gedung Pewayangan Kautaman, Jakarta, pada Rabu (11/11/2026).

Forum internasional yang mengusung tema “Wayang – Jembatan Emas Menuju Inklusivitas Global” ini dibuka secara resmi oleh Deputi Bidang Koordinasi Penguatan Karakter dan Jati Diri Bangsa Kemenko PMK, Warsito, mewakili Menteri Koordinator Bidang Pembangunan Manusia dan Kebudayaan (Menko PMK) Sugiono, yang ditandai dengan prosesi pemukulan gong.

Deputi Warsito menegaskan bahwa wayang memiliki potensi strategis sebagai ruang perjumpaan berbagai peradaban. Rangkaian nilai kebijaksanaan, keadilan, keberanian, dan toleransi yang melekat kuat di dalam lakon pewayangan dinilai sangat relevan untuk menjawab dinamika kehidupan masyarakat dunia. Oleh karenanya, pendekatan budaya ini harus terus direvitalisasi agar tetap relevan di mata kelompok lintas generasi.

“Wayang tidak boleh hanya kita pandang sebagai warisan masa lalu yang harus dijaga, tetapi sebagai warisan budaya yang terus hidup, berkembang, dan memberi makna bagi generasi masa kini. Wayang harus mampu menjangkau anak-anak muda tanpa kehilangan nilai luhur yang menjadi ruhnya,” ujar Deputi Warsito.

Guna menjamin keberlanjutan ekosistem tersebut, Deputi Warsito memaparkan empat langkah konkret yang perlu dipacu bersama. Langkah pertama adalah memperkuat regenerasi dengan membuka ruang berkreasi seluas-luasnya bagi dalang muda, mengeksplorasi lakon yang adaptif dengan realitas kekinian, serta mengoptimalkan pemanfaatan media digital.

Langkah kedua menitikberatkan pada penguatan basis sanggar dan komunitas, melalui pembinaan berkesinambungan bagi dalang, perajin, dan penabuh gamelan bersinergi dengan Kementerian Kebudayaan. Langkah ketiga berfokus pada perluasan jangkauan diplomasi budaya melalui kolaborasi pementasan lintas negara.

Sementara itu, langkah keempat berorientasi pada penetapan sasaran pelestarian yang terukur, mulai dari pemetaan jumlah pelaku seni muda yang dibina, perluasan basis penonton domestik, hingga intensitas pertunjukan di kancah internasional. Kemenko PMK memastikan akan terus mengawal koordinasi ini agar seluruh komitmen di atas mampu menghasilkan dampak pelestarian yang nyata di lapangan.

Lebih lanjut, Deputi Warsito meyakini bahwa seni pertunjukan wayang memiliki kedalaman estetika—baik secara visual maupun musikal—yang terbukti mudah diterima oleh dunia internasional. Kapasitas untuk menjembatani perbedaan inilah yang membuat wayang memegang peranan esensial dalam memperkenalkan wajah harmoni Indonesia.

“Wayang memiliki bahasa universal yang dapat melampaui batas negara, bahasa, dan latar belakang budaya. Melalui kolaborasi dan diplomasi budaya, wayang dapat menjadi jembatan persahabatan antarbangsa sekaligus memperkenalkan nilai toleransi dan penghormatan terhadap keberagaman,” tambahnya.

Mengakhiri arahan tersebut, Deputi Warsito mengajak seluruh pemangku kepentingan agar forum internasional ini tidak berhenti sebatas seremoni, melainkan harus diterjemahkan ke dalam program kerja yang konkret. Pemerintah senantiasa mendorong pelindungan warisan budaya, pendataan pelaku seni, serta penguatan kapasitas komunitas agar ekosistem seni Nusantara ini dapat terus produktif berkarya dan bermakna bagi generasi mendatang.

Kemenko PMK turut memberikan apresiasi tinggi kepada Senawangi atas komitmennya dalam membudayakan wayang di tengah masyarakat. Keberhasilan inisiatif ini diharapkan mampu membawa panggung Nusantara menuju panggung dunia sebagai jembatan persahabatan universal.

Kegiatan kebudayaan ini dihadiri oleh perwakilan Duta Besar Singapura untuk Indonesia, Mathew Lim; Ketua Umum Senawangi, F.H. Bambang Sulistyono; Staf Khusus Menteri Pertahanan Bidang Tata Negara, Kris Wijoyo Soepandji; Pelaksana Tugas Direktur Diplomasi Publik Kementerian Luar Negeri, Joneri Alimin; serta para pegiat seni mancanegara dari Singapura, Rusia, Uni Eropa, Filipina, hingga Hong Kong.

Rangkaian forum diplomasi budaya ini juga dihadiri oleh penasihat opera dan teater boneka internasional dari APA Singapura, Chua Soo Pong; delegasi Russian House, Maria Khionaki; Deputy Head of Mission Uni Eropa, Sthepane Mechati; perwakilan Teatrong Mulang Filipina, Danny Liwanag; serta perwakilan Sky Bird Puppet Group Hong Kong, Cheung Chun Fai. Hadir pula jajaran pimpinan organisasi kebudayaan nasional, meliputi PEPADI, UNIMA Indonesia, KSBN, Kowani, Merah Putih, serta segenap pembina dan pengurus Senawangi dan Pewangi.

Presiden Prabowo Perintahkan Menko PMK Bangun Sekolah Unggulan di Nagan Raya dalam 18 Bulan

Nagan Raya, 11 November 2026 – Presiden RI Prabowo Subianto menginstruksikan Menteri Koordinator Bidang Pembangunan Manusia dan Kebudayaan (Menko PMK) Sugiono untuk segera membangun sekolah unggulan bertaraf internasional di Kabupaten Nagan Raya, Aceh. Presiden menargetkan pembangunan sekolah tersebut rampung dalam waktu 18 bulan.

Instruksi itu disampaikan langsung Presiden Prabowo di hadapan jajaran pemerintah daerah dan masyarakat Aceh saat menghadiri peresmian dan revitalisasi Masjid Giok di Kabupaten Nagan Raya, Rabu (11/11).

Presiden Prabowo mengungkapkan rencana pemerintah pusat menghadirkan sekolah unggulan dengan fasilitas pendidikan berstandar internasional. Sekolah itu akan dilengkapi asrama bagi peserta didik yang tinggal jauh dari lokasi sekolah.

“Untuk yang desanya agak jauh, anak-anak yang sekolah di situ akan diasramakan, yang dekat-dekat dia boleh pulang tiap hari. Tapi yang jelas mungkin Nagan Raya salah satu yang pertama di Indonesia yang akan punya (sekolah unggulan), “ungkapnya.

Presiden Prabowo menegaskan bahwa pemerintah pusat siap merealisasikan pembangunan sekolah tersebut sepanjang pemerintah daerah segera menyediakan lahan yang dibutuhkan. Ketersediaan lahan menjadi kunci agar pembangunan dapat langsung dimulai tanpa harus menunggu terlalu lama.

“Saya katakan ke Bupati, asal, asal daerah siapkan lahan, pemerintah pusat akan bangun segera,” jelasnya.

“Ini ada Menteri Menko Pembangunan Manusia dan Kebudayaan, pendidikan di bawah beliau, dan saya kasih instruksi segera. Begitu lahan beres, segera dibangun, “ lanjutnya.

Dalam kesempatan itu, Presiden langsung meminta kepastian kepada Menko PMK Sugiono, yang juga putra kelahiran Aceh, mengenai waktu yang dibutuhkan untuk menyelesaikan pembangunan sekolah tersebut. Presiden bahkan sempat melontarkan pertanyaan spontan saat meminta komitmen penyelesaian proyek pendidikan itu.

“Menko PMK sanggup berapa lama kampus jadi? Loh kok ragu-ragu? Berapa lama? Satu tahun? Ya saya kasih waktu 18 bulan lah. 18 bulan jadi, insyaallah. Paling lambat 24 bulan, “ tegasnya.

Dengan target tersebut, Presiden berharap sekolah unggulan di Nagan Raya sudah dapat digunakan untuk kegiatan belajar mengajar paling lambat dua tahun setelah pembangunan dimulai.

Presiden Prabowo juga menegaskan bahwa kualitas pendidikan yang akan dihadirkan tidak boleh kalah dengan sekolah-sekolah internasional di luar negeri.

“(Dalam) 24 bulan, murid-murid sudah belajar di sekolah itu. Ini akan (jadi) sekolah yang setara dengan sekolah-sekolah internasional di luar negeri," terangnya.

UNDIP, Semarang (13/11) – Dalam rangka mendukung implementasi SDGs, Universitas Diponegoro ( UNDIP ) hadir menjadi tuan rumah “Global Youth SDG Innovation Camp: International Olympiad and Science Technology Competition for Sustainability (IOSTC) 2026”, bekerja sama dengan Cita Inovasi Indonesia (CII), melalui agenda yang diselenggarakan pada 10–16 November 2026 di kampus UNDIP Semarang.

Kegiatan internasional ini mempertemukan 204 inovator muda dari 12 negara yaitu Hungaria, Meksiko, Italia, El Salvador, Luxemburg, Denmark, Algeria, Cina, Nepal, Malaysia, Singapura, dan Indonesia dalam forum pengembangan sains dan teknologi sekaligus mendorong kontribusi nyata dalam mendukung pencapaian Tujuan Pembangunan Berkelanjutan atau Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).

Hadir mewakili Rektor UNDIP Prof. Dr. Suharnomo, S.E., M.Si., Wakil Rektor Riset, Inovasi, Kerja Sama dan Komunikasi Publik, Wijayanto, S.IP., M.Si., Ph.D. membuka acara Global Youth SDG Innovation Camp 2026 dan mengucapkan selamat datang kepada seluruh peserta yang hadir dari berbagai penjuru negara dan berkumpul di gedung Prof. Sudarto SH pada Rabu, 11 November 2026.

Wijayanto mengungkapkan, “Forum ini adalah langkah UNDIP untuk mendukung SDG ke-4 Quality Education, SDG ke-11 Sustainable Cities and Communities, dan SDG ke-17 Partnerships for the Goals. Dengan membangun komunitas epistemik global, UNDIP menciptakan solusi bagi permasalahan di masyarakat terutama penanggulangan bencana di Pulau Jawa. Bersama kita ciptakan solusi dengan teknologi dan inovasi serta kolaborasi antar bangsa.”

Kepala SDGs Center UNDIP Prof. Bulan Prabawani, S.Sos., M.M., Ph.D. , mengatakan bahwa di sini para inovator muda bisa mengembangkan gagasan inovasi dan bisnis yang tentunya memiliki relevansi terhadap kebutuhan sosial, ekonomi, dan lingkungan. “Dalam acara ini juga terdapat agenda City Tour, di mana para peserta bisa berkorelasi antara penelitian laboratorium, kegiatan lapangan, serta target dari SDGs itu sendiri,” tuturnya.

Sementara Prof. Dr. Ing. Ir. Suherman, S.T., M.T. selaku Ketua LPPM UNDIP mendukung kegiatan ini untuk meningkatkan kerja sama riset, inovasi, dan publikasi dengan institusi lokal maupun internasional.

Lembaga Penelitian dan Pengabdian kepada Masyarakat (LPPM) UNDIP melalui CoREM UNDIP (Center for Coastal Rehabilitation and Disaster Mitigation Studies) dan SDGs Center UNDIP mengakomodasi rangkaian kegiatan Global Youth SDG Innovation Camp 2026 meliputi Olympiad (siswa SMP dan SMA), Science Fair (siswa SMP, SMA, dan mahasiswa), dan Business Plan (siswa SMA dan mahasiswa). Dari kompetisi ini, akan dipilih pemenang Grand Prix yang mendapatkan hadiah berupa 3 (tiga) bulan mentoring riset.

Global Youth SDG Innovation Camp 2026 juga membahas mengenai permasalahan di Pantai Utara Pulau Jawa (Pantura), antara lain kenaikan level air laut perairan Indonesia sekitar 10-12cm pada tahun ini, kondisi penurunan tanah, dan bencana banjir rob termasuk di Semarang yang telah tercatat oleh Badan Riset dan Inovasi Nasional (BRIN).

Rangkaian kegiatan camp juga meliputi Sustainability Workshops yang mengangkat 5 (lima) tema permasalahan di pesisir Semarang meliputi polusi (pollution) , rob (tidal flooding), penurunan muka tanah (land subsidence), limbah (waste), dan ketahanan pangan (food security). Kelima workshop tersebut diselenggarakan dalam 5 (lima) kelas, yaitu:

Clean Water, Living Coast Lab (Diskusi Panel: Dessy Ariyanti, S.T., M.T., Ph.D.; Prof. Yayuk Astuti, S.Si., Ph.D.; dan Prof. Dr Denny Nugroho Sugianto, S.T., M.Si.)

Tempeh and Mangrove Foods for Resilient Coastal Communities Lab (Diskusi Panel: Prof. Dr. Diana Nur Afifah, S.TP., M.Si. dan Prof. Bulan Prabawani, S.Sos., M.M., Ph.D.)

From Waste to Resource: Circular Coast Lab (Diskusi Panel: Bayu Prasetyo, S.Kom., M.M.)

Safe, Fresh, Resilient: Preserving Local Foods Lab (Diskusi Panel: Ahmad Ni’matullah Al-Baarri, S.Pt., M.P., Ph.D.)

Living with the Tide: From Raised Floors to Floating Homes Lab (Diskusi Panel: Prof. Dr. Ing. Wiwandari Handayani, S.T., M.T., M.P.S. dan Prof. Rukuh Setiadi, S.T., MEM., Ph.D.)

Kompetisi ini melibatkan 11 juri yang memiliki latar belakang keilmuan dan profesional dari berbagai negara. Mereka adalah Denny Nugroho Sugianto (Indonesia), Tan Tao Kuang (Cina), Alex Muller (Luxemburg), Chia Wei (Singapura), Rukuh Setiadi (Indonesia), Diana Nur Afifah (Indonesia), Dessy Ariyanti (Indonesia), Ardiaz Ajie Aryandika (Indonesia), Rendy Ega Pradana (Indonesia), Yayuk Astuti (Indonesia), serta Prita Elriza dari Cita Inovasi Indonesia.

Melalui penyelenggaraan Global Youth SDG Innovation Camp 2026, UNDIP memperkuat perannya dalam membangun ekosistem inovasi yang berkontribusi terhadap solusi permasalahan global. UNDIP, Semarang (13/11) – Universitas Diponegoro ( UNDIP ) melalui inovasi dr. Muslimin, Sp.D.V.E., Subsp. O.B.K., FINSDV, FAADV beserta tim dari Fakultas Kedokteran menghadirkan pendekatan terapi kombinasi ozon dan Platelet-Rich Plasma (PRP) untuk membantu mempercepat penyembuhan ulkus lepra. Inovasi ini membuka peluang pengembangan layanan kesehatan bagi pasien kusta yang mengalami luka kronis dan berisiko mengalami kecacatan hingga amputasi.

Ulkus lepra merupakan luka kronis akibat kerusakan saraf yang menyebabkan berkurangnya kepekaan kulit, terutama pada telapak kaki. Kondisi tersebut membuat luka sulit sembuh dan rentan mengalami komplikasi. Perawatan konvensional, seperti pembersihan jaringan luka dan penggunaan balutan steril, belum selalu memberikan hasil optimal, sehingga diperlukan pendekatan terapi tambahan yang mendukung regenerasi jaringan.

Menurut dr. Muslimin, keunggulan inovasi ini terletak pada pemanfaatan dua pendekatan biologis yang saling melengkapi. “Terapi ozon berperan membantu mengendalikan mikroorganisme dan merangsang proses penyembuhan, sedangkan PRP yang berasal dari darah pasien sendiri mengandung faktor pertumbuhan untuk mendukung perbaikan jaringan dan pembentukan pembuluh darah baru,” katanya

Inovasi tersebut telah melalui uji klinis pada 29 pasien ulkus lepra di RS Kusta Donorojo, Jepara. Evaluasi dilakukan selama 6 minggu dengan membandingkan terapi standar, penambahan ozon, penambahan PRP, serta kombinasi keduanya. Hasilnya menunjukkan bahwa kelompok penerima terapi tambahan mengalami pengecilan luas luka yang bermakna secara statistik dibandingkan dengan kelompok yang menerima terapi standar.

Meski demikian, kombinasi kedua terapi tersebut belum menunjukkan keunggulan yang konsisten pada seluruh indikator biologis penyembuhan. Oleh karena itu, inovasi ini masih memerlukan pengembangan dan penelitian lebih lanjut. Variasi kadar trombosit dalam PRP autolog yang dapat berbeda antarpasien, serta banyaknya pasien berusia lanjut, menjadi faktor yang perlu diperhatikan dalam evaluasi hasil terapi. Kondisi tersebut memungkinkan beberapa parameter luaran belum menunjukkan hasil yang bermakna secara statistik, meskipun penyembuhan luka menunjukkan hasil yang lebih baik.

Temuan ini membuka peluang pengembangan terapi pendamping yang lebih efektif dan berorientasi pada kebutuhan pasien. Ke depan, inovasi tersebut berpotensi dikembangkan melalui kolaborasi dengan rumah sakit, fasilitas pelayanan kesehatan, industri teknologi medis, serta mitra dalam pengembangan layanan kesehatan. Pengujian lanjutan, standardisasi prosedur, dan evaluasi keamanan tetap diperlukan sebelum penerapan secara lebih luas.

Sebagai unit pengelola inovasi dan layanan Kekayaan Intelektual (KI) di UNDIP, Direktorat Inovasi dan Kerja Sama (Dirinovki) berperan dalam memfasilitasi identifikasi potensi KI, pendampingan perlindungan KI, serta pengembangan jejaring kemitraan untuk mendukung hilirisasi inovasi. Peran ini penting agar inovasi kesehatan memiliki landasan perlindungan yang tepat serta peluang pemanfaatan yang berkelanjutan.

Inovasi ini sejalan dengan komitmen Universitas Diponegoro dalam mendukung pencapaian Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), khususnya SDG 3 (Kehidupan Sehat dan Sejahtera) melalui pengembangan pendekatan terapi untuk membantu penyembuhan ulkus lepra dan meningkatkan kualitas layanan kesehatan,

Melalui penguatan inovasi, perlindungan KI, dan kolaborasi lintas sektor, UNDIP terus mendorong pengembangan solusi kesehatan yang relevan dengan kebutuhan masyarakat. Langkah ini mencerminkan semangat “UNDIP Bermartabat dan Bermanfaat” dengan menghadirkan inovasi unggul, berdampak, dan berkelanjutan untuk meningkatkan kualitas hidup masyarakat. Beranda Nasional Soal Kasus Penyadapan Presiden, Guru Besar Unair Sebut Eks Kapolri Listyo Sigit Hanya Jalankan Order

FAJAR.CO.ID, SURABAYA – Guru Besar Universitas Airlangga (Unair) Prof Henri Subiakto memberikan tanggapan terkait polemik dugaan penyadapan terhadap Presiden dan sejumlah tokoh nasional. Ia menduga mantan Kapolri Listyo Sigit Prabowo bukanlah pengguna akhir atau end user dari praktik penyadapan tersebut.

Melalui unggahan di akun media sosial X pribadinya pada Rabu (18/11/2026), Henri menilai terdapat pihak lain yang memberikan perintah dalam aktivitas penyadapan yang dinilai tidak memiliki dasar aturan undang-undang itu.

"Tidak Mungkin Listyosigit itu end user penyadapan. Pasti ada yang order padanya. Sampai kurun waktu tertentu, Polisi menyadap sengaja dibiarkan oleh atasannya yaitu presiden. Kenapa penyadapan dilakukan secara ilegal tanpa tata kelolanya diatur UU?" ucap Henri dilansir dari X pribadinya, Rabu (18/11/2026).

Menurut pandangan Henri, praktik pemantauan komunikasi tersebut pada masa lalu digunakan sebagai instrumen politik untuk memetakan gerak-gerik kelompok kritis, mengumpulkan bahan kompromat, hingga mengendalikan opini publik sebelum munculnya gerakan yang merugikan penguasa.

"Maka Penyadapan massif saat itu tak lain untuk Menekan oposisi. Mengawasi dan memonitor Aktivis, mengunci partai politik, dan kelompok masyarakat sipil, secara real-time," ucap Henri.

Ia menjelaskan lebih lanjut bahwa metode pemantauan komunikasi terhadap elite maupun warga negara tersebut berpotensi dimanfaatkan untuk mencegah rencana aksi atau kritik sejak dini melalui pengumpulan data digital secara menyeluruh.

"Itulah bentuk “licik” model Pengendalian informasi dan opini. Data penyadapan digabung dengan pantauan media sosial, lokasi, dan perilaku online untuk menargetkan disinformasi, sensor selektif, atau propaganda yang lebih tepat sasaran. Itu terjadi sebelum presidennya Prabowo," ujarnya.

Henri menyoroti bahwa situasi menjadi sorotan luas publik setelah praktik penyadapan tersebut dilaporkan turut menyasar Presiden Prabowo. Meski demikian, ia meragukan apabila mantan pimpinan tertinggi kepolisian tersebut berdiri sebagai aktor tunggal maupun dalang utama di balik peristiwa ini.

"Pantas saja selama ini mereka bisa merajalela dan efektif mengendalikan politik. Persoalannya, apakah Listyosigit ini puncak piramid pelaku makar itu? Saya kok tidak percaya demikian," ucapnya.

Menutup pernyataannya, Henri mengaitkan terbongkarnya kasus ini dengan dinamika politik nasional yang terjadi belakangan ini, sekaligus mengajak publik untuk menelusuri lebih jauh pihak yang berada di balik layar.

Beranda Politik Frederik Kalalembang: Biarlah Masyarakat yang Menilai

FAJAR.CO.ID, JAKARTA – Anggota DPR RI dari Daerah Pemilihan Sulawesi Selatan III, Irjen Pol. (Purn.) Frederik Kalalembang, menegaskan bahwa pengabdian seorang wakil rakyat harus diukur dari manfaat nyata yang dirasakan masyarakat, bukan sekadar seberapa sering terlihat atau diberitakan.

Menurut Frederik, kepercayaan masyarakat pada Pemilu 2024 merupakan amanah yang harus dipertanggungjawabkan melalui kerja nyata selama menjalankan tugas sebagai wakil rakyat.

“Bagi saya, yang terpenting adalah apa yang dapat kita perbuat dan berikan kepada masyarakat. Biarlah masyarakat sendiri yang melihat, merasakan, dan menilai hasil pengabdian kita,” ujar Frederik, Rabu (18/11/2026).

Pernyataan tersebut disampaikan Frederik menanggapi pemberitaan yang menyoroti intensitas kunjungan anggota DPR RI ke Kota Palopo, Sulawesi Selatan.

Ia justru menyambut positif apabila semakin banyak anggota dewan yang aktif turun ke daerah, membangun komunikasi, dan memberikan perhatian kepada masyarakat.

“Puji Tuhan apabila ada rekan-rekan anggota dewan yang dapat hadir dan membantu masyarakat. Tentu ini sesuatu yang baik dan patut diapresiasi. Sebab, pada akhirnya masyarakatlah yang merasakan manfaat dari setiap perhatian dan bantuan yang diberikan,” katanya.

Menurut Frederik, semakin sering seorang wakil rakyat hadir dan berinteraksi langsung dengan masyarakat, semakin besar pula kesempatan untuk memahami persoalan serta memperjuangkan aspirasi yang berkembang.

Namun, ia mengingatkan bahwa kemajuan teknologi komunikasi memungkinkan seorang wakil rakyat tetap hadir memberikan perhatian dan bantuan meskipun tidak selalu berada secara fisik di suatu daerah.

“Semakin banyak kita bersosialisasi dengan masyarakat tentu semakin baik. Tetapi di era teknologi sekarang, pengabdian tidak lagi dibatasi oleh ruang dan waktu. Kapan pun masyarakat membutuhkan bantuan, baik persoalan sosial, hukum, pelayanan publik, maupun berbagai kebutuhan lainnya, kita harus tetap dapat berkomunikasi dan berupaya mencarikan solusi,” jelasnya.

Frederik menilai teknologi memberikan kemudahan bagi anggota DPR RI untuk memantau perkembangan daerah pemilihannya, menerima aspirasi, serta membangun koordinasi dengan berbagai pihak.

“Saya sering menyampaikan bahwa saya mungkin tidak ada di situ, tetapi saya ada di mana-mana. Artinya, dengan segenggam handphone, kita bisa mengetahui berbagai persoalan yang terjadi di tengah masyarakat, membangun komunikasi, dan mengambil langkah untuk membantu mencari penyelesaiannya,” ungkapnya.

MUHAMMADIYAH.OR.ID, JAKARTA – Amal usaha Muhammadiyah memiliki tiga fungsi utama yang tidak dapat dipisahkan, yakni pendidikan, dakwah, dan perkaderan. Ketiganya perlu berjalan beriringan agar amal usaha tidak hanya menjadi institusi pelayanan, tetapi juga menjadi sarana aktualisasi nilai-nilai Islam dan penguatan kontribusi Muhammadiyah bagi umat dan bangsa.

Hal tersebut disampaikan Sekretaris Umum Pimpinan Pusat (PP) Muhammadiyah Abdul Mu’ti dalam peringatan Milad ke-71 Universitas Muhammadiyah Jakarta (UMJ), Milad ke-114 Muhammadiyah, dan Hari Bermuhammadiyah ke-14, Rabu (18/11), di Auditorium K.H. Ahmad Azhar Basyir, Gedung Cendekia UMJ.

Abdul Mu’ti menjelaskan, amal usaha Muhammadiyah merupakan bentuk nyata dari aktualisasi, institusionalisasi, konkretisasi, dan objektifikasi amal saleh. Karena itu, nilai-nilai Islam tidak cukup disampaikan dalam bentuk gagasan dan narasi, tetapi harus diwujudkan melalui praktik kelembagaan yang dapat dirasakan manfaatnya oleh masyarakat.

“UMJ perlu melaksanakan paling tidak tiga fungsi kaitannya dengan amal usaha Muhammadiyah itu. Yang pertama adalah fungsi pendidikan, yang kedua fungsi dakwah, dan yang ketiga fungsi perkaderan. Ketiga-tiganya tidak dapat dipisahkan,” ungkapnya.

Dalam fungsi pendidikan, amal usaha Muhammadiyah perlu terus meningkatkan kualitas akademik melalui penguatan riset mutakhir dan publikasi yang diakui pada tingkat nasional maupun internasional. Peningkatan kualitas tersebut menjadi bagian dari upaya membangun keunggulan institusi yang dapat dipertanggungjawabkan secara akademik.

Sementara itu, fungsi dakwah perlu tercermin dalam kehidupan dan tata kelola amal usaha. Menurut Abdul Mu’ti, keberadaan institusi pendidikan Muhammadiyah harus menghadirkan suasana keislaman yang nyata, sehingga Islam tidak berhenti sebagai slogan, tetapi menjadi landasan dalam kehidupan sehari-hari.

Adapun fungsi perkaderan diarahkan untuk melahirkan kader persyarikatan, kader umat, dan kader bangsa yang tangguh. Dengan demikian, amal usaha Muhammadiyah tidak hanya menghasilkan layanan pendidikan, tetapi juga berkontribusi dalam menyiapkan generasi penerus yang mampu melanjutkan perjuangan persyarikatan dan memberikan manfaat bagi masyarakat.

Lebih lanjut, Abdul Mu’ti menegaskan bahwa tata kelola kelembagaan menjadi salah satu kunci kemajuan amal usaha Muhammadiyah. Pengelolaan organisasi perlu ditopang sistem yang baik, tetapi tetap memiliki fleksibilitas agar mampu merespons perubahan dan mengembangkan berbagai inovasi.

“Tata kelola organisasi yang terlembaga dengan baik adalah kunci kemajuan kita,” tegasnya.

Ia juga mengingatkan agar amal usaha Muhammadiyah tidak terjebak dalam pelaksanaan kegiatan yang biasa-biasa saja. Setiap institusi perlu terus melakukan penyempurnaan dan terobosan agar memiliki keunggulan yang diakui masyarakat secara objektif.

Dalam momentum Milad ke-114 Muhammadiyah, Abdul Mu’ti berharap seluruh amal usaha dapat semakin menghadirkan manfaat bagi masyarakat luas. Keunggulan institusi, menurutnya, perlu dibuktikan melalui kontribusi nyata, sehingga masyarakat dengan berbagai latar belakang dapat merasakan manfaat keberadaan Muhammadiyah. (Taufik)

MUHAMMADIYAH.OR.ID YOGYAKARTA – Di balik angka ratusan ribu pertanyaan yang masuk ke sistem ChatHPT, laporan data analitik Wakil Ketua Majelis Pustaka dan Informatika (MPI) Pimpinan Pusat (PP) Muhammadiyah, Ismail Fahmi menunjukkan selama dua belas hari peluncurannya mengungkapkan pola perilaku digital yang menarik dari pengguna ChatHPT dalam mengakses bimbingan keagamaan.

Ismail mendapati waktu penggunaan ChatHPT oleh pengguna sangat erat dengan ritme ibadah dan aktivitas harian umat. Berdasarkan peta panas aktivitas sistem, volume pertanyaan mulai merangkak naik sejak terbitnya fajar, menguat pada sesi pagi pukul 09.00-11.59 WIB, lalu sedikit melandai pada siang hari.

Puncak kesibukan digital harian secara konsisten terjadi pada pukul 18.00-18.59 WIB atau menjelang Maghrib, yang menyumbang 7,0% dari total pertanyaan harian. Tidak kalah menarik, sekitar 8% dari total pertanyaan justru masuk pada rentang waktu Subuh yaitu pukul 04.00-06.59 WIB, yang selaras dengan tingginya volume pertanyaan praktis seputar tata cara shalat, wudhu, dan doa harian.

“Temuan paling menarik adalah ritme bertanya warga mengikuti ritme ibadah. Volume mulai naik sejak waktu Subuh, menguat pada pagi hari, sedikit melandai saat siang, lalu memuncak menjelang Maghrib,” ujar Ismail.

Lebih lanjut, laporan tersebut juga mencatat adanya fenomena unik di luar jam-jam konvensional. Tercatat ada lebih dari 5.000 pertanyaan yang masuk pada rentang tengah malam hingga pukul 04.00 WIB.

“Warga juga tetap bertanya pada jam istirahat. Lebih dari 5 ribu pertanyaan masuk antara tengah malam dan pukul 04.00. Pertanyaan mereka singkat dan langsung, rata-rata hanya tujuh kata,” sebutnya

Penggunaan ChatHPT, bagi Ismail, hadir dan bertransformasi menjadi ruang alternatif bagi masyarakat untuk mencari rujukan keagamaan ketika para ustaz atau pemuka agama setempat umumnya sudah beristirahat. Di samping itu, juga sekadar menggunakannya untuk menyiapkan khutbah, kultum, dan konten dakwah.

“Pada pagi hari ChatHPT membantu persoalan keseharian seperti muamalah, utang-piutang, dan transaksi digital. Pada malam hari, ChatHPT menjadi ruang bertanya untuk urusan keluarga yang seringkali terasa sensitif untuk ditanyakan kepada orang lain,” jelas Ismail.

Kendati demikian, tingginya interaksi digital ini tetap diiringi catatan penting dari para pengembang dan Majelis Tarjih agar umat tetap menjadikan teknologi ini sebagai pintu pembuka rujukan, serta senantiasa memverifikasi substansi hukum dan dalilnya kepada para ulama dan naskah resmi persyarikatan. “ChatHPT adalah pintu menuju khazanah tarjih, bukan pengganti ulama atau fatwa. Warga tetap dianjurkan membaca naskah tarjih yang dirujuk dalam setiap jawaban,” pungkas Ismail. (Alam)

MUHAMMADIYAH.OR.ID, JAKARTA — Ketua Pimpinan Pusat (PP) Muhammadiyah Kiai Saad Ibrahim menjelaskan makna beriman kepada perkara gaib sebagaimana disebutkan dalam Al-Qur’an surah Al-Baqarah ayat 3. Menurutnya, keimanan kepada yang gaib merupakan salah satu karakter utama orang bertakwa. Keimanan tersebut harus disertai pembenaran dan kesediaan menjalankan konsekuensi dari apa yang diyakini.

Hal itu disampaikan Kiai Saad dalam program Tausiah Kiai Saad TVMu yang tayang pada Sabtu (14/11). Dalam ceramahnya, ia mengawali pembahasan dengan mengutip surah Al-Baqarah ayat 3, alladzīna yu’minūna bil-ghaibi wa yuqīmūnash-shalāta wa mimmā razaqnāhum yunfiqūn, yang berarti orang-orang yang beriman kepada yang gaib, mendirikan salat, dan menginfakkan sebagian rezeki yang Allah berikan kepada mereka.

Ia menjelaskan bahwa ayat tersebut merupakan bagian dari uraian mengenai karakter orang-orang bertakwa (lil muttaqīn) yang disebutkan dalam ayat sebelumnya. Al-Qur’an menjadi petunjuk bagi orang bertakwa, yang salah satu cirinya adalah memiliki keimanan kepada perkara gaib.

Merujuk Tafsir al-Tabari, Kiai Saad menerangkan beberapa pengertian tentang perkara gaib. Makna pertama berkaitan dengan Al-Qur’an itu sendiri. Dalam pengertian ini, beriman kepada yang gaib dapat dimaknai sebagai kepercayaan kepada Al-Qur’an sebagai kitab petunjuk.

Kata yu’minūna, lanjutnya, juga memiliki makna yuṣaddiqūna, yakni membenarkan. Artinya, iman tidak berhenti pada pengakuan bahwa sesuatu itu benar, tetapi harus diikuti dengan pembenaran yang tercermin dalam tindakan.

“Orang yang percaya kepada Al-Qur’an tentu harus membaca, menelaah, mengambil pelajaran, kemudian menerapkannya dalam kehidupan,” jelasnya.

Menurut Kiai Saad, seseorang yang mengaku percaya kepada Al-Qur’an, tetapi mengabaikan konsekuensi dari kepercayaannya, belum menunjukkan hakikat keimanan secara utuh. Pembenaran terhadap Al-Qur’an menuntut kesediaan untuk mempelajari dan mengamalkan petunjuk yang terkandung di dalamnya.

Makna kedua dari perkara gaib berkaitan dengan rukun iman, terutama kepercayaan terhadap kehidupan akhirat. Dalam penjelasan ini, perkara gaib mencakup surga, neraka, dan seluruh hal yang berada di luar jangkauan pengetahuan manusia.

Kiai Saad mengingatkan bahwa kehidupan akhirat tidak dapat dipandang sebagai mitos atau sekadar gambaran yang diciptakan manusia untuk menghibur diri ketika tidak memperoleh keadilan di dunia. Pandangan yang menganggap surga dan neraka sebagai proyeksi psikologis manusia, menurutnya, bertentangan dengan ajaran Islam.

Ia menegaskan bahwa surga dan neraka merupakan kenyataan yang harus diyakini oleh orang beriman. Bahkan, keberadaan kehidupan akhirat dapat dijelaskan melalui pertimbangan rasional mengenai keadilan.

Menurutnya, kehidupan dunia memperlihatkan banyak kebaikan yang tidak memperoleh balasan setimpal. Sebaliknya, berbagai kejahatan juga tidak selalu mendapatkan hukuman yang semestinya. Jika kehidupan berakhir begitu saja setelah kematian, persoalan keadilan tersebut tidak memperoleh penyelesaian.

“Banyak kebaikan yang tidak terbalaskan dalam kehidupan dunia. Banyak juga kejahatan yang tidak mendapatkan hukuman. Maka, di situlah harus ada mahkamah pada hari kiamat,” paparnya.

Melalui pengadilan pada hari kiamat, Allah akan memperhitungkan seluruh amal manusia dan memberikan balasan atas kebaikan maupun keburukan yang telah dilakukan. Balasan di akhirat memiliki nilai yang jauh melampaui apa pun yang dapat diperoleh manusia selama hidup di dunia.

Selain pertimbangan keadilan, Kiai Saad juga mengajak umat Islam menyadari keterbatasan pengetahuan manusia. Menurutnya, keterbatasan itu bahkan terlihat ketika manusia berhadapan dengan sesuatu yang secara fisik dapat diamati.

Ia mencontohkan luasnya alam semesta yang belum mampu dijangkau seluruhnya oleh pengetahuan manusia. Bintang terdekat di luar tata surya, Proxima Centauri, misalnya, berjarak sekitar empat tahun cahaya dari bumi. Jarak tersebut menunjukkan betapa luasnya alam semesta dibandingkan kemampuan manusia untuk menjangkaunya.

Bahkan, sesuatu yang berada di sekitar manusia pun belum tentu dapat diketahui secara langsung melalui pancaindra. Atom, misalnya, merupakan bagian dari kenyataan alam yang keberadaannya diyakini meskipun tidak dapat dilihat dengan mata telanjang.

Dari kenyataan tersebut, Kiai Saad mengajak umat Islam memahami bahwa tidak semua yang ada dapat diketahui manusia. Karena itu, keterbatasan pengetahuan tidak dapat dijadikan alasan untuk menolak keberadaan sesuatu yang belum diketahui.

“Yang tidak diketahui tidak selalu berarti tidak ada,” tegasnya.

Ia menambahkan, manusia perlu menyadari adanya Zat Yang Maha Mengetahui, yakni Allah Swt. Betapapun luas dan mendalam pengetahuan yang berhasil dicapai manusia, semuanya tetap sangat kecil dibandingkan ilmu Allah yang meliputi segala sesuatu.

Bagi Kiai Saad, keyakinan kepada perkara gaib memiliki landasan keagamaan sekaligus dapat dipahami melalui pertimbangan rasional dan kenyataan empiris. Manusia perlu mengakui batas-batas pengetahuannya serta tidak menjadikan apa yang belum mampu dijangkau akal dan pancaindra sebagai sesuatu yang pasti tidak ada.

Claude’s paid plans now include whiteboards, sheets and Data, each suited to a different kind of work. Whiteboards turn ideas into editable layouts, while sheets pairs a spreadsheet with an assistant and Data builds dashboards from uploaded information. In one test, a whiteboard mapped a beginner workout event with a $300 promotional budget, as demonstrated by The AI Advantage.

Compare Claude sheets with Google Sheets to see where similar AI-assisted results meet different limits on features and sharing. Explore how a whiteboard can organize an event plan or workflow while leaving room for edits. Then examine how to add focused views to a Data dashboard and check whether the result follows the original instructions.

Claude sheets is an AI-centered spreadsheet with Google Sheets and Excel imports, but it lacks pivot tables, macros and other advanced features. In a six-month gym revenue and expense test, Claude sheets and Google Sheets with the Claude extension produced virtually identical results. Google Sheets was stronger for sharing and collaboration, and there appeared to be no reason to migrate. Claude whiteboards turn early ideas into editable visual layouts. In a test, Claude created an event flow and checklist for a beginner workout with a $300 promotional budget. Claude Data creates dashboards and focused slide views from uploaded information. One test needed follow-up to fill in missed details; whether focused views can be reapplied to other data views is unconfirmed. Claude’s features are on all paid plans, while ChatGPT spaces are on the $100 plan. Spaces lack whiteboards but offer native image generation, which Claude does not have.

Claude sheets opens as an editable spreadsheet with import buttons for Google Sheets and Excel. Its interface centers on AI: after you submit data and a prompt, Claude works inside the sheet, with a sidebar showing the assistant alongside the document.

The spreadsheet is narrower than its established counterparts. It lacks pivot tables, which readjust around data, and macros, or multi-step presets, as well as many other advanced features. Google Sheets, by comparison, has a wide range of functions in its data tab alone.

To test the feature, the team created a fictional Phoenix gym owner, John, and his business, Desert Strength. The task was to make a sheet covering six months of revenue and John’s expenses. After the team uploaded the data with a short contextual prompt, Claude completed the task.

The team then ran the same task in Google Sheets using Anthropic’s official Claude extension, which also provides a sidebar. In Google Sheets, Claude made a plan first rather than starting work immediately, but the results were virtually the same. On that basis, the in-sheet AI experience is not yet a distinctive reason to switch.

Sharing is another difference. Claude requires people to be invited to a Claude account or to use a shared account; making content public might also be possible. Google Sheets came across as the stronger choice for sharing, and a connector also lets you work directly inside a Google Sheet from Claude.

A small, quick task could be faster in Claude sheets, but there appeared to be no reason to migrate from Google Sheets, given its established use and how well it works with AI.

Claude whiteboards take a less structured approach than a sheet or slide deck. They can turn a brainstorming session into a visual layout, making them useful when ideas are still taking shape or have not yet found an obvious place in a project.

The Desert Strength example gives John a different task: planning a free beginner workout with a $300 promotional budget and presenting the idea to his team. In the test, Artifacts was opened, Whiteboard and Ask Claude were selected, and the example was supplied. Claude laid out the plan visually, with an event flow and checklist.

This free-flowing format proved appealing for organizational charts, workflows and event plans, particularly during ideation. It could also serve as a visual backup for a pitch or presentation. Miro and Whimsical already offer whiteboarding and flowcharts; the creator has not let AI pilot those tools, and says he might start now that a whiteboard sits inside Claude.

Other examples show how a layout can be changed. A team-created whiteboard tracing a coffee bean from farm to cup could be restyled and given a chart. In an event-notes example, changing the promotional budget updated the editable whiteboard.

For team collaboration more broadly, Google Sheets remained the stronger choice in testing: people know the interface and can add data, tabs and alternatives or link things together. Whiteboards instead offer a more flexible way to explore alternatives, map a workflow or sketch an application or feature before building it.

Here are more detailed guides and articles that you may find helpful on Claude Artifacts and sheets.

Claude Data provides a standardized route from uploaded information to a dashboard. The resulting dashboards proved good, and Claude came across as having been among the strongest tools for this kind of work.

You can also add slides to a dashboard in a new tab, creating a visual explainer focused on a particular part of the data. This could provide a short visual story after the main dashboard or draw attention to one aspect of a presentation. Similar results were possible before by prompting and building submenus in a website, but the new workflow makes focused views quicker to create.

The results did need correction in one case. In a storyteller test about gaps in a company’s revenue, Claude missed some instructions, and the team had to follow up to get the requested details filled in. That need for follow-up proved unusual with Claude. Natural-language requests can often prompt the tool to make the desired adjustments.

The creator guesses that presets may sit behind Data’s visualization workflow and hopes the easily created views can be reapplied to other data views. Those possibilities sit alongside the demonstrated ability to build a base dashboard and add a more focused view.

Claude’s artifact collection also includes documents, slides and Claude design, which can make graphics and videos. Sheets and whiteboard are the two new additions; the other artifacts have been available for longer, with Data renamed from dashboards.

ChatGPT spaces offer some similar functions, including pages and slides, but are available only on the $100 plan as of now. They do not have Claude’s whiteboard feature. Their advantage is native image generation, including photorealistic images using a person’s likeness.

Claude design has proved good at visuals and arguably the best at videos, particularly with Fable 5.2. But Claude does not have native image generation. Photorealistic images of you would require an outside image source, such as a Higgsfield connection or a fal.ai API. Separately, Fable 5.2 proved strong for creative work.

A ChatGPT Business addition lets a business connect with ChatGPT. It came across as an AI-era Yellow Pages, and registered businesses are expected to be recommended over unregistered ones.

Dots custom instructions now accept rules and behavior up to 35,000 characters; previously, Dots could not accept system instructions. The creator welcomes the change but wants Dots to reach the $20 plan, while the feature discussed remains on the $100 plan.

The AI Advantage sees whiteboards as a planning interface for visual thinkers and Data as a way to build dashboards and focused views. It sees no reason for Google Sheets users to migrate: the gym test produced virtually identical results, and Claude sheets lacks pivot tables and macros. The AI Advantage hopes the focused views can be reapplied to whatever kind of data view you are creating. Access is another dividing line: Claude’s features are on all paid plans, while ChatGPT spaces are on the $100 plan.

Apple has unveiled iOS 27.3 Developer Beta 2, a feature-packed update that emphasizes usability, health integration, and cross-platform functionality. With the official public release anticipated in mid-December, this beta provides an in-depth preview of the enhancements iPhone users can expect. From redesigned native apps to advanced AI tools, this update reflects Apple’s ongoing commitment to refining the ecosystem experience. Below is an exploration of the key features and their practical benefits.

Optimized Calendar Navigation: App controls and search options have shifted to the bottom menu bar for improved one-handed accessibility. Siri Health & Web AI: Siri gains permission-based access to Apple Health data and introduces “Ask About Page” functionality to read and summarize entire Safari web articles. iPhone Duo Upgrades: Introduces front-camera-based facial recognition unlocking alongside a new “Close to Lock” folding preference. Ecosystem Continuity: Companion betas roll out across iPadOS, watchOS, visionOS, and macOS 27.3 with updated Full Disk Access privacy controls.

The Calendar app in iOS 27.3 Beta 2 has been redesigned with accessibility and ease of use in mind. Synology’s NAS software combines file storage, photo management and backups in one system. Open source projects can replace many of those functions on compatible hardware, but setup and integration often require more work. No open source replacement with the same range of capabilities as Active Backup for Business has been identified, according to SpaceRex.

Compare storage management options for selecting an operating system and setting up shares on your own hardware. The feature also examines file syncing and photo libraries, including the account and permission differences that affect how applications work together. Finally, consider application backup consistency and the need to coordinate database dumps with stored files when planning a restore.

TrueNAS SCALE now officially branded as TrueNAS Community Edition is probably DSM’s strongest open source competitor, offering ZFS-based storage and many core NAS functions. DSM was found to be more user-friendly; OpenMediaVault was found to be powerful and simpler to deploy than TrueNAS. Nextcloud offers file syncing and collaboration, but felt somewhat slow and buggy, and its users and permissions do not automatically sync with TrueNAS. Immich proved faster than Synology Photos and avoids its HEIC limitations, but lacks integration with Synology Drive. Active Backup for Business backs up computers and servers without a license fee, while Synology’s backup offerings also protect Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace. SpaceRex knows of no open source alternative that matches this breadth. rclone supports more connections than Synology Drive, but was found less user-friendly than Cloud Sync. motionEye is probably the best-known open source surveillance alternative, though notifications and camera compatibility can need more attention. Hyper Backup handles both files and application backup consistency. SpaceRex is unsure whether one alternative can reproduce everything it handles; replacing it requires accounting for each application’s files and databases.

DSM runs a Synology NAS’s core functions, from storage management to user accounts and networking. Synology is the NAS market leader because of its software and applications, rather than its hardware or prices.

TrueNAS SCALE is probably DSM’s strongest open source competitor. It offers ZFS-based storage and many of the same core functions: you can manage pools, users and networking; create SMB and NFS shares and iSCSI blocks; and set up scrub tasks and email notifications. It is also probably the default choice for advanced users building on their own hardware.

DSM was found to be more user-friendly, particularly when adding users, setting permissions and navigating the system. TrueNAS also permits some damaging mistakes that Synology would prevent. For example, restoring a snapshot to the wrong location can wipe data. Its reporting gives a less convenient view of system metrics than Synology’s resource manager.

On user-selected hardware, TrueNAS cannot identify the exact slot of a failing drive as DSM can on Synology hardware. TrueNAS Enterprise does offer that visibility, though it was found to be expensive. TrueNAS is also moving away from a strictly open source license. The change has caused community controversy but is not expected to affect users greatly.

OpenMediaVault is another option. It was found to be powerful and simpler to deploy than TrueNAS. Open source operating systems can run on a wide choice of hardware, including x86 machines or ARM systems where the software is compatible. XPEnology aims to reproduce Synology functionality using its source code, but it was not found to be a good option because of its issues and the availability of easier alternatives.

Synology Drive and Synology Office turn NAS storage into a shared document and file platform. They support public sharing, Synology Docs and local syncing on Mac, Windows and Linux. On Mac and Windows, on-demand sync shows files without keeping every file locally; a file downloads when you open it.

Nextcloud is a fully open source competitor with document editing, Markdown files, collaboration, external sharing and on-demand sync on macOS and Windows. Its application ecosystem also includes Nextcloud Talk and a calendar. Those additional applications appeared better developed than Synology’s calendar equivalent, but Nextcloud felt somewhat slow and buggy. Those issues have kept it from becoming the primary office file server in use.

There are integration differences when Nextcloud runs alongside TrueNAS. An SMB edit appears immediately in Synology Drive, while a file changed on a TrueNAS server needs a sync before Nextcloud recognizes it, although there are ways around that. DSM accounts and permissions carry across its applications; TrueNAS users and permissions do not automatically sync to Nextcloud. That gap is not an issue if your deployment lives entirely within Nextcloud’s own applications.

Synology Photos combines mobile backup, sharing and AI features. A shared family library has been used for about five years, including older family photographs that relatives can search by face.

Immich is a close alternative with mobile phone backup. It proved faster than Synology Photos and does not have Synology’s HEIC limitations. It has its own users and photo storage, however, so you lose the integration between Synology Photos and Synology Drive. Nextcloud Photos provides another option if you have less demanding photo needs.

Browse through more resources below from our in-depth content covering more areas on open source NAS alternatives.

Active Backup for Business can back up Windows servers and computers, macOS computers and Linux servers to a Synology without a license fee. It offers bare-metal restore, which can rebuild a drive as it was, and global file deduplication. Synology’s backup offerings can also protect MS365 and Google Workspace data with restore options.

If your business uses cloud storage, one Synology box can therefore collect computer, server and cloud backups at a fixed cost. That combination was found to be a major reason to deploy a NAS, and no other open source option has been found that does the same job.

Time Machine can cover this kind of backup in a Mac-only environment, but it cannot back up servers or MS365 and Google Workspace. That leaves a gap if you want the same breadth of protection with an entirely open source replacement.

Synology Cloud Sync supports download-only, upload-only and two-way transfers with cloud services. You can manage schedules and priorities in one place and, for example, keep a company’s Dropbox data locally or send local data to the cloud.

rclone is the open source project that Cloud Sync uses in the background. It supports a larger range of connections than Synology Drive, including storage systems Synology has not added. Some integrations no longer work, however, and iCloud Drive works inconsistently. rclone is mainly command-line driven; its new web interface is expected to help, although it was found to be less user-friendly than Cloud Sync.

For cameras, Surveillance Station records to a Synology NAS. UniFi generally came across as the better choice, except for a setup with one camera, but UniFi is not open source in the sense discussed here.

motionEye is probably the best-known open source surveillance alternative. You can use it as a set-and-forget system without pursuing its more complex features, though notifications and camera compatibility can need more attention. For larger camera deployments, dedicated applications or boxes looked preferable: constant recording on a NAS can affect the rest of the storage pool’s performance.

Hyper Backup protects folders and Synology packages to destinations including another NAS, a USB drive, cloud services, an S3 bucket or a server using rsync or WebDAV. Its advantage goes beyond copying files: it also handles application backup consistency and matches the file system to the database dump time.

That matters for an application such as Nextcloud, which has a database as well as files. A file-system copy of a database may restore corrupt if changes had not been written to disk during the backup. It is unclear whether any single alternative fully matches Hyper Backup across the applications it protects.

On Btrfs systems, Hyper Backup takes a snapshot at the start and sends files as they were at that point. By contrast, rsync copies files individually, so changes during a backup can leave an inconsistent state. TrueNAS offers snapshot replication, and replication is also an option with ZFS or Btrfs.

Database dump tools for PostgreSQL, MariaDB and MySQL can create consistent database files, but you must account for them alongside application files. Hourly PostgreSQL and MariaDB dumps required separate setup, and a restore would require matching them to the file-system backup time.

SpaceRex thinks home users who are comfortable tinkering and do not have a massive number of users can replace much of their Synology setup with open source software. For those relying on Active Backup for Business, he knows of no open source alternative. He is also unsure whether one tool can reproduce everything Hyper Backup handles; replacing it means accounting for each application’s files and databases.

Less familiar Excel functions can handle everyday spreadsheet tasks that might otherwise require manual checks or extra calculations. CONVERT, for example, changes 174 miles to about 280 kilometers using the unit codes “mi” and “km”; those codes are case sensitive. The example comes from a freight worksheet demonstrated by My Online Training Hub.

Use FORMULATEXT and TYPE to identify overwritten formulas and numbers stored as text, then examine how CELL and SHEET can keep workbook details current. The guide also shows how DATEDIF calculates complete years and remaining months between dates, including the need to place the earlier date first and avoid the unreliable MD unit.

CONVERT changes measurements between units and can fill an entire table column automatically. Unit codes are case sensitive, and CONVERT does not handle currency. FORMULATEXT can expose hard-coded values in place of formulas; IFNA and conditional formatting can flag them. TYPE identifies numbers stored as text, which can otherwise be missed by calculations such as SUBTOTAL. CELL, TEXTAFTER, SHEET and SHEETS can keep workbook and sheet details current in headers. N can add a note inside a numeric formula without changing its result. ROMAN and ARABIC convert numbers to and from Roman numerals. TRANSLATE and DETECTLANGUAGE help with languages; TRANSLATE requires Microsoft 365 and an internet connection, and its wording should be checked. DATEDIF calculates time between dates, including complete years and remaining months. Microsoft warns that its MD unit can produce negative, zero or inaccurate results for some date combinations.

CONVERT changes measurements between units, such as miles and kilometers or Fahrenheit and Celsius. In Excel, you can use it in a table to convert an entire column automatically.

On the route sheet of Harbor Lane Logistics, a practice freight business in Portland, a formula converts 174 miles to 280 kilometers for a new Canadian customer. It takes the distance as its number, “mi” as the from-unit and “km” as the to-unit. Excel copies the formula down the table automatically.

A second table references values and unit codes in columns K and L to convert pallet weight, warehouse temperature, fuel, transit time and container length. You can change the units in their cells, but unit codes are case sensitive: a lowercase “c” or a misspelled code produces an N/A error.

Excel’s IntelliSense displays a complete list of CONVERT units, although the unordered list can be tricky to search. CONVERT does not handle currency; Excel puts currency conversions in the currencies data type on the Data tab.

FORMULATEXT displays a cell’s underlying formula as text, helping you spot an overwritten calculation. Because it can return only a formula, it produces an N/A error in Harbor Lane’s third-quarter report where someone typed 5% into cell D10. The figure matches the expected result, but is likely to be wrong when actuals change the following month, without a warning.

Wrapping FORMULATEXT in IFNA replaces the error with “hard coded.” You can then use conditional formatting to mark cells containing that text with a light red fill and dark red text.

TYPE helps you find values that look numeric but are stored as text. In September orders copied from an ordering system, SUBTOTAL reports 19,565 instead of 32,705 because it ignores three text amounts. TYPE returns 2 for those entries in rows 8, 11 and 13. After you convert them to numbers, every TYPE result is 1 and the total is correct.

TYPE also returns 4 for a logical value, 16 for an error, 64 for an array and 128 for compound data. ISNUMBER instead returns TRUE for numbers and FALSE otherwise, so TYPE gives you more detail when examining an unfamiliar file from another system.

If warning flags are missing, check that background error checking is on under Error Checking in the Formulas options, then use Reset Ignored Errors if needed. A flagged cell offers an option to convert its contents to a number.

CELL can return a workbook’s path using any cell on the sheet as a reference. The result includes the file name in square brackets and the sheet name at the end. This can help you keep headers current: Harbor Lane’s manually typed report headers contain a file path, sheet name and sheet position, but could be out of date within a week.

TEXTAFTER extracts the sheet name using the first closing bracket as its delimiter. Outside Microsoft 365, you can instead use MID and FIND to locate that bracket and return the following characters.

SHEET and SHEETS provide the current sheet’s position and the workbook’s sheet count. In the example, a header changes from “sheet four of eight” to “sheet five of nine” after a sheet is added and the current one is moved. SHEET can also take a tab name: the “type” sheet is third in the example.

The N function lets you put a note inside a formula. Harbor Lane’s example records that its 4% commission rate was agreed with finance in August and is due for review in January. N turns the quoted note into zero, leaving the calculation unchanged. The note is limited to 255 characters, and the technique is really suitable only for formulas that return a number.

Keeping the note inside the formula makes it less likely to become separated from the calculation than a cell comment or note. N can also convert dates to serial numbers and TRUE to 1.

ROMAN and ARABIC convert numbers in opposite directions. ROMAN turns 14 into XIV for a document cover and handles values up to 3999. ARABIC converts scanned contract clause numbers back into numbers, so you can sort the example list by that column.

BAHTTEXT has written numbers as Thai words for more than 20 years. Combined with TRANSLATE, it can turn those words into another supported language. In the invoice example, the language codes TH and EN produce English text, although the result still contains Baht and Satang.

Two nested SUBSTITUTE calls replace those terms with dollars and cents, without VBA. TRANSLATE requires Microsoft 365 and an internet connection, and you should check its machine-translated wording before use.

TRANSLATE also converts product descriptions from English to Spanish for a customer in Mexico, with the same Microsoft 365, internet and machine-translation conditions. DETECTLANGUAGE can identify the language of text in a supplier spreadsheet when it is unknown.

DATEDIF calculates the time between dates, even though Excel offers no autocomplete or tooltip for it and does not show it in the function wizard or insert function dialogue. Excel retains the function for compatibility with Lotus 1-2-3 workbooks.

In the HR example, start dates are in column D and the report date is in F4. The Y unit returns complete years; YM returns the remaining months; and YD returns days left after complete years. MD returns days left after months, but Microsoft warns it can produce a negative number, zero or an inaccurate result for some date combinations.

Combining Y and YM with text gives a years-and-months figure for service, ages, contract lengths or overdue invoices. The start date must come before the end date, or DATEDIF returns an error. For the days calculation, My Online Training Hub would avoid MD given Microsoft’s warning about its results for some date combinations.

The Steam Machine leads next-generation consoles in reported developer targeting, according to a November 2026 Game Developers Conference survey. Of more than 2,600 developers surveyed, 21% reported targeting Valve’s living room PC, compared with 10% for the next PlayStation and 8% for Microsoft’s Project Helix. The figures measure development targets, not sales, as noted by Water CS2.

Explore how shared Steam Deck verification and SteamOS support can make the machine a practical target for developers. The feature also examines the constraints of its 8 GB of video memory and what optimization for that hardware could mean for games on Windows and Linux PCs, including systems that exceed its specifications.

In GDC’s survey of more than 2,600 developers, 21% targeted Steam Machine for current or upcoming projects, compared with 10% for the next PlayStation and 8% for Project Helix. These figures track development targets, not sales. The base Steam Machine started at $1,049. Its 6-inch cube contains a six-core AMD Zen 4 processor, an RDNA 3 GPU, 8 GB of video memory and 16 GB of system memory. In demanding tests cited in the review, the GPU and 8 GB video-memory buffer reached their limits. Reviewers said modern blockbusters on a 4K TV required settings at least as low as medium and heavy use of AMD FSR upscaling for a steady frame rate. Steam Deck and Steam Machine share the SteamOS software stack. Valve’s guidelines say a game that passes Steam Deck Verified automatically qualifies as Steam Machine Verified. Water CS2 says players with Windows or Linux PCs exceeding Steam Machine’s specifications can benefit from optimization work for its fixed hardware without buying the machine.

The base Steam Machine started at $1,049, well above the price of a standard console. Its components fit inside a 6-inch cube:

Valve described the machine as roughly six times more powerful than the Steam Deck. For living room gaming, its raw horsepower is roughly comparable to a standard PlayStation 5.

Demanding benchmarks cited in the review included Black Myth: Wukong and Cyberpunk 2077 with ray tracing on. In those tests, the 8 GB video-memory buffer and mid-range GPU met their limits. Reviewers said playing modern blockbusters on a 4K living room TV required settings at least as low as medium and heavy use of AMD’s FSR upscaling to hold a steady frame rate.

GDC’s survey polled more than 2,600 developers worldwide about the platforms for their current and upcoming projects. PC led at 81%, followed by PlayStation 5 and PS5 Pro at 45% and Xbox Series X and S at 37%. The survey listed Steam Deck at 32 and Nintendo Switch 2 at 29%.

The Steam Machine’s 21% result places it ahead of the next PlayStation at 10% and Project Helix at 8% in the survey. That is not a sales lead: the figures track development targets, and current-generation PlayStation 5 consoles still dominate the living room market.

The Galaxy Buds Pro are ideal for individuals who prioritize comfort and situational awareness over complete sound isolation. Their innovative features, thoughtful design and reliable performance make them a compelling choice in the growing market of open-ear wireless earbuds.

The Samsung Galaxy Buds Pro redefine what open-ear wireless earbuds can offer, combining innovative features with a design that prioritizes comfort and awareness. XREAL Aura pairs lightweight glasses with a separate Android XR compute puck for a launch price of $1,099. MRTV says the price will rise by $200, though the timing is unclear. In MRTV’s first session, the image looked sharp and the blend of physical and virtual views felt convincing. Hand tracking responded well to aiming and pinching, while six-degrees-of-freedom tracking kept virtual objects steady as the wearer moved. The puck’s touchpad also worked well as a controller. XREAL Aura combines lightweight glasses with a separate Android XR computer for a launch price of $1,099. In an initial session, hand tracking responded well to aiming and pinching. Virtual objects also stayed fixed as the wearer looked around and moved closer.

MRTV’s first impressions were highly positive, particularly for how the glasses combine virtual objects with a direct view of the surroundings. MRTV calls Aura a huge deal that may help bring the technology further into the mainstream.

XREAL’s first Android XR headset uses a phone-sized compute unit rather than a phone. MRTV says the price will rise by $200, in a remark tied to the end of the year, though the timing of the increase is unclear.

The aluminum compute puck runs Android XR and has a touchpad where a phone screen would sit. You can control the system with the touchpad or hand gestures. An aluminum-accented clip attaches the puck to trousers or other objects.

The puck is light for its size and has a premium feel. Its power port accepts DisplayPort input, so you can connect a Steam Deck, MacBook or another device with USB-C video output. You can also connect the glasses directly to a USB-C video-out device, including a Steam Deck or MacBook Air.

Asked why a standard Android phone could not house the computer, XREAL’s team told MRTV that the puck is more powerful and dissipates heat better than a Samsung Galaxy Fold 8. That is why a phone cannot house the computing hardware right now.

Here are more detailed guides and articles that you may find helpful on XREAL Aura glasses.

The glasses use prism lenses like those in the XREAL One series. Their outward-facing cameras handle hand tracking and six degrees of freedom tracking rather than recording people nearby. A separate camera lets AI and Gemini see what you see, and a flashing LED indicates when it records.

You can angle each stem independently, an adjustment recommended for the best visuals. The fitted nose pad places your eyes closer to the lenses, but you can swap it for more standard pads that position your eyes farther away. XREAL changed the nose pads for Aura. Buttons select headset modes and adjust volume or brightness, while speakers sit close to your ears.

Given the limited room for speakers, the audio is not expected to be better than that of other glasses of this kind. A USB-C port connects the glasses to the puck or another device. The angled end of the supplied cable goes into the glasses, and the other end connects to the bottom of the puck.

Small holes hold a lens insert that you can take to an optician for personal lenses. XREAL also sells inserts, for what MRTV believes is $69. Inserts from XREAL One Series headsets fitted and worked, so new ones were not needed for Aura.

The included case holds the computer at the top and the glasses at the bottom. It has a separate cable compartment, a microfiber cloth and a lock to keep it closed during storage. It holds everything needed for spatial computing. The box also contains a quick-start guide, a charging cable, nose pads and the insert for glasses wearers.

The case is sturdy, well made and thoughtfully arranged. It is much smaller than the Apple Vision Pro case, for which MRTV paid more than $200. Aura itself is also much smaller and cheaper than Apple’s headset.

The Aura glasses will feel familiar to anyone who has used the XREAL One Pro Plus. During first setup, display alignment involved placing a finger inside a virtual object as it moved closer. Seeing XR features familiar from Vision Pro in glasses this small made a strong impression.

Aura uses optical passthrough: you see your surroundings directly through the glasses, with virtual elements laid over them. That differs from the video passthrough used by Apple Vision Pro and Meta devices. XREAL tried real-photon AR when the company was called Nreal, but that effort came too early.

Because the view of the room is direct, it has the full resolution of the wearer’s own eyes. MRTV says it is the first time this real-photon approach to AR has worked so well.

In the first session, a virtual menu appeared alongside the room, and virtual objects looked as though they were floating in front of the wearer. The image looked clear, with vibrant colors and perfect blacks, and the blend of physical and virtual views was particularly convincing. A panorama and immersive 3D content were also viewed.

Six degrees of freedom tracking kept virtual objects steady as the wearer turned or approached them. Hand tracking worked very well in the first impression: aiming and pinching produced a laser-like pointer. The puck also tracked well when used as a thumb-operated mouse pad.

The mixed-reality field of view is restricted, but it feels natural in Android XR because the glasses themselves appear to form the boundary. The view reached their edges and felt larger than on older XREAL devices.

That impression changes in VR apps, which black out the surrounding environment. There, the field of view is quite similar to XREAL One Pro Plus, and a VR headset remains preferable for especially immersive experiences.

Aura’s 1,900-by-1,200 resolution is not much higher than that of other XREAL devices and competitors in the same space, and is not far from the XREAL One Pro Plus. The image looks very sharp because the resolution is concentrated within a limited field of view. People who found the One Pro Plus resolution insufficient probably will not see a huge difference.

The battery indication fell only a little during an hour of use. The first impression is that battery life seems quite good, though it needs a long-term test.

MRTV says Aura works exceptionally well for watching content, working and using apps in mixed reality, with virtual objects held steady as the wearer moves. Battery life seems quite good after an hour, but still needs a long-term test. For highly immersive VR, MRTV prefers a VR headset: Aura’s limited field of view becomes more apparent when apps black out the surroundings.

The number of zero-day vulnerabilities, flaws exploited before a patch is available, has risen sharply. Between January and August 2025, vulnerabilities discovered and exploited increased steadily, from five to six in January to nearly 25 in June, peaking at 30 in August. In the past week alone, around 99 vulnerabilities were identified, including 14 in Copeland refrigerator controllers.

Over the last six months, zero-day vulnerabilities have surpassed end-day vulnerabilities in frequency. Attackers have exploited zero days to breach 21 management servers, installing crypto miners before patches were released. These servers, located in the US, South Africa, Canada, the UK, Germany, France, and Sweden, were compromised on the same day the vulnerabilities were exploited. This highlights how quickly zero-day flaws are being weaponized.

Threat actors are automating the reverse engineering of patches, enabling them to weaponize vulnerabilities faster than ever. This trend poses a serious challenge, as developers struggle to address vulnerabilities before exploitation occurs. The increasing frequency of zero-day incidents underscores the growing sophistication of cyberattacks, often driven by AI-powered tools.

AI’s role in cybercrime extends beyond hacking into areas like cyber espionage and information operations. Threat actors are using large language models (LLMs) for credential theft, cloud resource compromise, and reselling access to high-performance AI models through underground services like LLM mixers. Financially motivated attackers are profiting from stolen credentials and compromised cloud resources.

In cyber espionage, AI tools are automating data analysis, target research, and supply chain attack vectors. Attackers are manipulating autonomous coding assistance and configurations to deploy backdoors, creating new opportunities for exploitation.

In information operations, LLMs are generating synthetic media at scale, creating localized personas, and automating cross-platform content distribution. State-sponsored groups and commercial influence-as-a-service vendors are using these capabilities to manipulate public opinion and monetize inauthentic political networks.

The rapid development of AI-powered hacking tools is outpacing traditional cybersecurity measures. Many organizations have contributed to this vulnerability by deprioritizing security, resulting in weak security features and inadequate vulnerability testing. This has left more systems open to exploitation.

Threat actors are now targeting a broader range of devices, from Mac systems to smart appliances like refrigerators. Microsoft 365 phishing attempts and Teams meeting phishing are also on the rise, illustrating the diverse attack vectors being exploited.

Google claims to be addressing these challenges through a multi-pronged defense strategy, including proactive model-level safeguards, specialized threat intelligence, and targeted containment protocols. The company is also using its AI threat defense architecture to counter AI-driven attacks. GTIG employs an AI threat tracker to monitor agentic threat activity, improving its response to emerging threats.

Anthropic and OpenAI are also contributing by releasing cybersecurity AI frameworks designed to detect and prevent attacks. However, the scale and speed of AI-driven cybercrime remain a significant challenge for defenders.

The rise of AI-powered hacking marks a critical turning point in cybersecurity. Tools enabling automation, coordination, and unprecedented speed are lowering the barrier to entry for cybercriminals, making it easier to exploit vulnerabilities. The growing prevalence of zero-day incidents and increasingly sophisticated attacks highlight the urgent need for stronger defenses.

While companies like Google and OpenAI are developing AI frameworks to counter these threats, the scale and speed of AI-driven cybercrime pose a daunting challenge. For IT teams and administrators, staying ahead of thousands of coordinated AI agents is becoming increasingly difficult.
